title: Tiberian Factions for Red Alert
description:
[i]My son asked me who would win if GDI battled the Soviets. Now we can find out.[/i]

Tiberian Factions adds GDI and Nod from Tiberian Dawn, and GDI from Tiberian Sun, as fully playable factions in Red Alert Remastered. Five sides, one map: Allies, Soviets, GDI, Nod and TS GDI, in any mix, for you and the AI.

[b]Required for TS GDI:[/b] the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3819642604]Tiberian Sun HD Assets[/url].

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]GDI and Nod with full TD logic:[/b] complete tech trees with the Ion Cannon, Nuclear Strike, Obelisk of Light, navies and the A-10.
[*] [b]Tiberian Sun GDI, rebuilt in HD:[/b] Titans, Wolverines, Disruptors and the Mammoth Mk. II.
[*] [b]Separate tech trees:[/b] every faction builds its own base, and Unholy Alliance starts you with all five.
[*] [b]Every faction looks and sounds like itself:[/b] its own sidebar, radar logo, EVA, voices and music.
[*] [b]Tiberium[/b] that grows, spreads and hurts, on most of Red Alert's skirmish maps.
[*] [b]AI for all five factions[/b], Easy to Hard per slot, with a real economy and navies. It doesn't cheat!
[*] [b]Walls and gates[/b] for every faction, an all-new intro movie and a new front end.
[*] [b]Quality of life:[/b] attack-move, rally points, A* pathfinding, docking at any refinery, extra zoom, and a Deploy key for every faction.
[/list]

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[b]Version 5.6.0: A Melodic Performance Improvement[/b]
[list]
[*] New ADD-ONS screen: get and switch on the asset packs and add-ons straight from the main menu.
[*] Faction Encyclopedia: every faction's units and structures, with their in-game stats, from the main menu.
[*] Tiberian Sun's soundtrack as an add-on, and a new Settings page to pick each faction's skirmish music.
[*] All 34 of Tiberian Dawn's skirmish maps, on TD's own terrain.
[*] Pathfinding about twice as fast and about 400 MB less video memory.
[*] Units only come from their own faction's factories.
[*] LAN: H, the deploy key and building sounds work for every player.
[*] Your reports, fixed: paused units resume, the Dropship Bay shows its reload, and more.
[/list]
[b]Earlier versions[/b]
[list]
[*] 5.5: every Tiberian Sun GDI building, unit and infantry rebuilt in HD.
[*] 5.0: Tiberian Sun GDI, the intro movie, the UI overhaul, gates and walls, Tiberium on RA's maps.
[*] 4.0 to 4.2.1: navies, the A-10, support powers, separate tech trees, Unholy Alliance, per slot AI difficulty.
[*] 2.0 to 3.0: Tiberium, attack-move, A* pathfinding and the harvester economy.
[/list]
Complete changelog on GitHub:
https://github.com/gibbo101/cnc-ra-tiberian-factions/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

[h2]Planned[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Tiberian Sun Nod[/b] as a playable faction, in 6.0.
[*] [b]A balance pass for TS GDI and TS Nod.[/b]
[*] [b]Even Smarter AI[/b], including naval invasions.
[*] [b]Tiberian Factions campaigns.[/b]
[*] [b]Co-op missions[/b] for two players.
[/list]

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
[list]
[*] A [b]This is a DLL mod[/b]: disable other DLL mods, such as CFE Patch, before enabling it.
[*] [b]HD graphics only.[/b] Classic graphics mode is locked out, because the mod's units and buildings have no classic art.
[*] Skirmish is the main tested mode. LAN works and has had limited testing. Each player with their own faction's crest, EVA and hotkeys.
[*] Saved games from earlier versions of the mod will not load in 5.5; Load Game greys them out. This will prevent crashes.
[*] The stock Allied and Soviet campaigns are removed to make way for Tiberian Faction capaigns whilst the mod is enabled. Disable TF to play them.
[/list]

[h2]Known limitations[/h2]
[list]
[*] The TS GDI AI does not use Firestorm Defense or build the EMP Cannon, and builds no transports or navy on maps split by water (a TS GDI navy may come later).
[*] No faction's AI builds walls or gates.
[*] German and French players hear English voices.
[/list]

[h2]Source and licensing[/h2]
GitHub: https://github.com/gibbo101/cnc-ra-tiberian-factions
Built on top of [url=https://github.com/TheAssemblyArmada/Vanilla-Conquer]Vanilla Conquer[/url]. DLL source is [b]GPL v3[/b], inherited from EA's 2020 Remastered Collection source release.
